create.name: Mangala Shri Bhuti
create.bio:
Mangala Shri Bhuti is the Tibetan Buddhist community founded in the United States by Dzigar Kongtrul Rinpoche, a teacher of the Nyingma school who taught Buddhist philosophy at Naropa University in the early 1990s. He named it after the Sanskrit name of his own teacher, Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche, and it centres on the Longchen Nyingtik lineage of the Great Perfection. Rinpoche's son Dungse Jampal Norbu and Elizabeth Mattis Namgyel also give teachings, and senior students lead many of the regular sessions.

The sangha has two main practice centres, Phuntsok Choling near Boulder in Colorado and Pema Osel in Vershire, Vermont, with smaller groups in American cities and in Europe, Brazil and Japan. Its yearly highlight is the nine-day Nyingma Summer Seminar under a tent at Phuntsok Choling, which moves through the three vehicles of Tibetan Buddhism and is also streamed. Members can join a shedra study programme, practice retreats and drupchen ceremonies. Every Sunday it broadcasts a free audio talk and podcast called the Link. The YouTube channel, active since 2009, gathers short and full-length teachings by Rinpoche on bodhicitta, mind training and letting go, with talks by his fellow teachers and guests such as Pema Chödrön.

courses.title: Nyingma Summer Seminar 2027
courses.description: A nine-day seminar held under a tent at Phuntsok Choling in Ward, Colorado, and streamed live. Rinpoche and his two fellow teachers cover the Hinayana, Mahayana and Vajrayana in turn, with Pema Chödrön as guest. Registration opens in spring 2027.

courses.title: Mind at Ease
courses.description: A summer programme with Dzigar Kongtrul Rinpoche at Pema Osel in Vershire, Vermont, on Dzogchen, the Great Perfection teachings. Planned for August 2027; exact dates not yet published.

free_resources.title: The Link: Weekly Teaching and Podcast
free_resources.description: A free live audio talk each Sunday morning (US Mountain time) by Dungse Jampal Norbu or a senior student, on Buddhism from a practitioner's point of view, also released as a podcast with an archive of past talks.

free_resources.title: Foundational Teachings
free_resources.description: Short written teachings by Dzigar Kongtrul Rinpoche on core Buddhist ideas such as dependent origination and the four marks of existence.

flags: Close to an existing listing: Dzigar Kongtrul Rinpoche (dzigar-kongtrul-rinpoche) is listed with mangalashribhuti.org as his website. This plan lists his sangha as a separate organisation (two centres, other teachers, its own channel); owner may prefer to keep only his listing.

Teachers file links Dzigar Kongtrul Rinpoche as founder (history page says he founded the sangha) and Pema Chödrön as instructor (named as special guest teacher at the 2027 Nyingma Summer Seminar). Possible future listings: Elizabeth Mattis Namgyel, Dungse Jampal Norbu.
Base: the organisation's published address is a PO box in Crestone, Colorado (a small town); its main centres are in Ward, Colorado and Vershire, Vermont. Recorded as Crestone for mapping.
Email is the general secretary inbox listed in the contact page's directory; the page also has a form.
The site's images sit under /wp-content/uploads/, which its robots.txt disallows, so the photo is the channel avatar (the sangha's vajra-and-lotus logo).
'Mind at Ease' is dated only 'August 2027', so start_date is left empty.
